payload.title: Concurrent FMS build collision + Prisma 7 generator/RBAC mismatch
payload.detail: Both cline and claude-code are building the Franchise Management System from the same brief, in the same working tree, with no orchestrator scope split (plan-summary.yaml absent). claude-code created prisma/schema.prisma (cuid IDs, Membership/MembershipRole RBAC, prisma-client-js generator, datasource with NO url). cline created prisma.config.ts (Prisma 7 config supplying the datasource url), .env.example, lib/env.ts, and lib/rbac.ts (data-driven Role/Permission/UserRole RBAC). Two different RBAC models and a deprecated generator now coexist.
risks: Duplicate/conflicting schema and RBAC designs will corrupt the build if both agents keep writing
prisma-client-js is deprecated in Prisma 7.10.1; the Rust-free client requires provider=prisma-client + output
Race conditions on package.json, package-lock.json, and the generated client
claude-code's datasource block has no url, so prisma generate/validate depends on cline's prisma.config.ts
payload.proposal: Split scope and align on ONE RBAC model before either agent builds authorization. Suggested: claude-code owns prisma/** + data/repository layer + seed; cline owns auth/session, RBAC enforcement, server actions/services, API routes, app shell/UI, and the AI platform.
